content:
OpsBot: INCIDENT ALERT — service=embedding-service | symptom=503 spike | affected_regions=[us-west-2, eu-west-1] | pages: @Alex Chen @Mira Patel :rotating_light:
Alex Chen: taking primary. looking at autoscaler + evictions first. will start a bridge in ~2m.
Mira Patel: on secondary, standing by for logs and routing checks.
Alex Chen: bridge up: https://redwood.incident/bridge/7432109999 — starting with node-level metrics and recent deploys. initial metric: 503 rate = 4.8% over 5m, p95 latency from 220ms -> 1.3s.
Jordan Lee: saw correlated spikes in kv-cache evictions around the same time frame. possible cache thrash when embedding batch sizes increase.
Alex Chen: confirmed eviction bursts on nodes gpu-embed-*-prod. grabbing logs.
Alex Chen: logs snippet:
```
W 2026-03-15T12:04:13Z kv_cache.cpp:214 eviction triggered: tenant=acme-corp batch_sz=1024 memory=78%
E 2026-03-15T12:04:14Z inference_server.cpp:442 request_failed status=503 reason="k-v cache miss + oom fallback"
```
Mira Patel: checking autoscaler policy — looks like minReplicas=2, scaleUp cooldown 60s. traffic delta hit peak and autoscaler lagged.
Alex Chen: applying temporary mitigation: increase minReplicas -> 5 for embedding pool to reduce cold starts. running kubectl patch: `kubectl patch hpa embedding-pool -p '{"spec": {"minReplicas": 5}}' -n inference`
DeployBot: PATCH recorded by Alex Chen @ 2026-03-15T12:12:07Z — hpa/embedding-pool minReplicas: 2 -> 5
Jordan Lee: pushed a short-lived routing rule to divert small requests to optimized-embed-compact model (lower memory profile) to reduce pressure.
Priya Gomez: customer-impact quick check: incident affected ~12 customers with high-throughput embedding jobs. SLO errors increased; opened INC-4521 and notified SEs. top affected tenant: acme-corp (15% of their requests hit 503 during window).
Alex Chen: metrics after mitigation (12m after patch): 503 rate down to 0.6%, p95 back to ~280ms. autoscaler now stable at 6 pods.
Mira Patel: running through runbook checklist:
- confirm no recent model load changes (checked)
- confirm no deploys rolled at incident start (none)
- verify autoscaler events (scale up happened, no scale down flaps)
Runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/embedding-503 (see steps 1-6)
Jordan Lee: action item — add short-term KV cache lease bump for heavy tenants to reduce eviction churn. I'll put up a small config push in canary.
Alex Chen: canary for kv-lease bump deployed to 10% of traffic in eu-west-1. monitoring.
Priya Gomez: customer comms draft pinned in INC-4521. suggested language: apology, brief root cause (cache eviction under burst), mitigation steps taken, ETA for full fix (48-72h).
Alex Chen: current status: incident mitigated. residual monitoring only. next steps: Jordan to roll KV lease config to 100% after validation; Mira to keep autoscaler cooldown under watch and revert minReplicas change when safe; Priya to coordinate customer comms.
Mira Patel: handoff notes for next shift (primary/secondary):
- Primary: Mira Patel (overnight) — monitor embedding 503 rate and autoscaler events; pager escalation if 503 > 2% for 10m or p95 > 1s for 15m.
- Secondary: Jordan Lee — KV cache config rollouts + metrics checks; escalate to Alex if rollouts fail or we see node OOMs.
- On-call contact list: @Alex Chen, @Mira Patel, @Jordan Lee, SRE Pager (pager#).
Alex Chen: runbooks + dashboards:
- runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/embedding-503
- dashboard: https://dashboards.redwood/ops/embedding-service?range=15m
- logs query: `service:embedding-service severity:ERROR | parse "eviction"`
Jordan Lee: outstanding technical TODOs (not blocking handoff):
- add autoscaler metric smoothing to avoid rapid scale spikes (PR queued: gitlab.com/redwood/infra#1247)
- permanent KV lease tuning plan (design doc draft in product/embeddings/kv-lease.md)
Priya Gomez: customer impact summary for next shift: update INC-4521 with finalized comms, tag affected accounts, run postmortem template.
Alex Chen: final: incident closed for now — follow-up items documented in INC-4521 and linked PRs. handing over to Mira for overnight watch. :white_check_mark:
Mira Patel: acknowledged, taking over as primary. will post any notable changes here. :eyes:
